title: TFC River Particles+
description: A mod making tfc rivers a little more fancy
body:
Features:
- New particles on tfc rivers, like branches and leaves
- Larger river particle spawn radius around the player (adjustable)
- Optional water color noise (default off)
- Config options for the algorythms


The mod mixins into a bunch of tfc stuff, check the version compatibility on the download page, specific jars are for specific tfc versions only. Others may work but aren't tested.

This has been performance profiled and tested, and the default settings should have a minimal performance impact

I only uploaded this because i thought someone would like it too, i may not keep it updated, other versions are not planned.

! i used ai-help in the creation of this mod !
